name: DVGO Density and Color Rendering
definition: DVGO uses a shifted softplus as density activation to map stored values to non-negative densities, and a shallow MLP to map color features and positional encodings to view-dependent color emission.
summary: DVGO Density and Color Rendering decouples geometry and appearance into voxel grids and a neural network, using post-activation interpolation to produce sharp surfaces with lower grid resolution.
